corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the straight crossbar of 1st-order ተ, forming the standard Amharic gerundive አስተምሮ ('having taught').
The second character has the 6th-order left-side indentation of ህ, forming the Amharic demonstrative ይህማ ('as for this').
A stray ink speck below the stem of የ was misread as ዩ; the printed word is the standard Andemta phrase በየደጁ ('in its respective place/section').
Both the image and the Ge'ez citation (Acts 14:13, ወአምጽኡ ሜራ ዘድዮስ 'and the priest of Zeus brought...') show 1st-order አ in ወአምጽኡ.
The 3rd-order vowel foot on ጂ is visible on the right leg, forming the standard particle እንጂ.
